name: input
description: A single-line text input control. Built on the native HTML input element. Use for name, email, password, search, and any single-line text entry.

input-field.purpose: Complete form field with label, input, and description.

intent.Input: Single-line text entry. 36px height, horizontal layout.

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

composition.trailingSlotRule: Only one trailing slot should be visible at a time.

accessibility.role: textbox; textarea uses textbox with aria-multiline=true
accessibility.label: Associate label via htmlFor and id.
accessibility.disabled: Use disabled attribute; removes from tab order.

constraints: Use input-field for every standard form field.
Use raw input only inside custom wrappers that provide a label association.
Use Textarea only for multi-line free text.
Do not use Textarea for structured multi-value entry.
Only one trailing slot should be visible at a time.
Invalid description should contain the specific error.

useCases: User registration or account setup forms: name, email, phone, username fields
Login forms where a single line of text is collected (email + password)
Search bars paired with a button — use trailing-button with the input
Address entry: street, city, postcode — each as a separate input-field
API key or token display fields where the user reads or copies a value
Notes, comments, or bio fields that require multi-line entry (Type=Textarea)

Type=Input.whenToUse: Single-line text, number, email, password, or search entry

Type=Textarea.whenToUse: Free-form multi-line prose — the user needs more than one line

comparedTo.situation: User must type a free-form value — anything goes
User enters a verification or PIN code in individual slots
User needs to pick one value from a fixed list (no typing)
User needs to pick from a long list or select multiple values
User needs to add multiple tag-like values (email recipients, labels)
User must enter an exact number (quantity, amount, port)

notes: Examples assume InputField and Textarea wrappers around shadcn Input/Textarea; source markdown itself does not mark this component not ready.
Textarea has been separated into its own file: textarea.meta.json

changelog.change: Invalid state: blue focus ring replaced with red ring using [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector. Prevents blue ring appearing on focused invalid field.

darkMode.notes: Container fill uses color/input/bg (Dark: zinc/700) — one step lighter than surface/overlay so inputs stand out from the panel. Disabled fill uses color/surface/muted (Dark: zinc/800).

storybook.title: Forms/Input
storybook.notes: Input-only (single-line) stories. Textarea has its own separate story file and meta.json.

relatedComponents.name: textarea
relatedComponents.reason: Textarea is the multi-line version. Same token set, different height and vertical layout.

relatedComponents.name: combobox
relatedComponents.reason: Use combobox for searchable/filterable lists or multi-value tag entry.

relatedComponents.name: select
relatedComponents.reason: Use select for short fixed lists where typing is not needed.

relatedComponents.name: input-otp
relatedComponents.reason: Use input-otp for verification codes and PINs requiring individual slot entry.
